acceptance_reason: Required proptest lane has planned obligation PO-001-UNIT with exact command (PROPTEST_CASES=10 cargo test -p vb_storage --lib max_key_len_aliases_equal_journal_key_bytes) and workdir. Kani not_applicable is documented with concrete non_applicability_evidence_refs (proof-seeds hash 130ff5b4...) and limitation_kind surface_absent. The const-alias chain (MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN = JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES) has no exec fn, no loop, no arithmetic; verifying a const against itself is vacuous. The cargo check discharge is strictly stronger than a Kani harness would produce. Acceptable per references/verification-lane-policy.md Non-Applicability rule.

Verus not_applicable is documented with concrete non_applicability_evidence_refs and limitation_kind surface_absent. The existing TrimError::IncompleteTrim { deleted_count: u64 } variant at trimming/mod.rs:51 is preserved verbatim and its 0x4102 code is covered by error_code_tests.rs:246. No new exec fn is introduced; Verus is for Rust-local functional invariants, not for const alias equality. Acceptable.

Flux-rs not_applicable is documented with concrete non_applicability_evidence_refs and limitation_kind risk_out_of_scope. The cap is a usize const alias; refining a usize value already discharged by const X = JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES adds no information. Flux's SMT-decidable fragment targets refinement types (e.g., Offset stays within [0, LEN)), not const equality. Acceptable.

The decoder surface (decode_storage_key at keys.rs:346) already enforces length equality via KeyDecodeError::KeyLengthMismatch. Acceptable.
